# Nomadar Strengthens Its International Network with the Addition of LDR Sports


by[Press](https://nomadar.com/author/press/)


| Sep 23, 2026


|[News](https://nomadar.com/category/news/) |[0 comments](https://nomadar.com/nomadar-strengthens-its-international-network-with-the-addition-of-ldr-sports/#respond)


Nomadar has added LDR Sports, a football academy based in Madrid, as a new partner in its international network of collaborators. This alliance opens a new channel for the development of young players and expands the reach of the HPT (High Performance Training) program, which Nomadar has been building together with clubs, academies, and agencies from different countries.


LDR Sports is the academy behind the Elite Gap Year Football Program, founded by Pepe Lora, Nacho Rullan, and Daniel Salas to give young players a complete training experience in Madrid. Its approach combines high-level training with personal support, a philosophy that shares several similarities with the development model Nomadar applies within the HPT program.


With this new alliance, Nomadar and LDR Sports will begin exploring different ways to work together. Among the options being considered are organizing joint international camps and sending LDR Sports players to join the HPT (High Performance Training) program, adding them to the community of players from different countries who have already taken part in the program.


This addition strengthens Nomadar’s international network, which continues to grow with academies, clubs, and representation agencies from around the world, with the goal of giving more young talents the chance to train and compete in Spain.
